column1: # expect: cut or keep, whether the rule denies a sandbox allowed domain of the
# global settings. A WebFetch(domain:) deny also denies the host to the sandbox,
# which honors only a bare * and a leading *. that excludes the apex.
# An allowed domain, exactly or by a wildcard the sandbox honors, is cut
# Other domains, other wildcards, and the bare tool rule keep the sandbox as is
# gh run view --log downloads the run logs from the Actions results host
# Tool docs allowed to WebFetch are not sandbox domains, so a deny of them
# would leave the sandbox as is
# Blob storage stays outside: anyone can own an account there and receive data
